task_completion.description: Fetch and load the 2HBS structure into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '2HBS' or a similar name, and the 3D viewer displays a hemoglobin tetramer.

task_completion.description: Programmatically modify B-factors to 50.0 for hydrophobic and 10.0 for polar residues.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command history shows Python or PyMOL commands iterating over residues (ALA, VAL, ILE, etc.) and setting 'b' values.

task_completion.description: Create a surface representation colored by the modified B-factors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D viewer shows a molecular surface colored with a two-tone scheme (representing the 10.0 and 50.0 values) rather than standard element or chain coloring.

task_completion.description: Identify Valine 6 on Chains B and D and display them as spheres.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Specific residues at the start of two chains (B and D) are rendered as spheres, likely protruding from or embedded in the surface.

task_completion.description: Measure the intramolecular distance between Val6 CA and Phe85 CA on Chain B.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A distance measurement line (wizard or command) is visible in the viewer between two alpha carbons, with a label showing a value between 15.0 and 35.0 Angstroms.

task_completion.description: Save the modified PDB, the PNG image, and the text report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal or PyMOL logs show 'save', 'png', and file writing commands to the specified paths: ~/PyMOL_Data/structures/2HBS_hydrophobic.pdb, ~/PyMOL_Data/images/hbs_surface.png, and ~/PyMOL_Data/hbs_report.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 2HBS. Hydrophobic residues (ALA, VAL, ILE, LEU, MET, PHE, TRP, PRO, TYR) must be set to B-factor 50.0; others to 10.0. The mutation is Valine 6 on Chains B and D. The key hydrophobic pocket residues are Phe 85 and Leu 88. The expected intramolecular distance between Val6 (CA) and Phe85 (CA) on Chain B is between 15.0 and 35.0 Angstroms.
